EDGE CASE. Won the regular general election for the full term with 50.47% as an Independent; the Republican nominee on that ballot was Richard Kline (10.53%), Democrat Emily Firebaugh (37.28%). Missouri law barred her from the GOP primary after her husband Bill Emerson died. She simultaneously won the same-day special election for the unexpired term as the Republican nominee (not counted). Rejoined GOP January 1997.
